# Apple CEO John Ternus Says ‘I Really Like Where We're At’ in AI Race: Won't ‘Ship AI for AI's Sake’

Mohd Haider

2 min read

 AAPL

  -1.23%

Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) CEO John Ternus has defended the company's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, pushing back on criticism that the iPhone maker has fallen behind competitors in the AI race. [...] Ternus said Apple will "absolutely" use AI in its new products, according to WIRED. But he drew a line on how.

"We don't want to ship AI for AI's sake," he said. "When we're doing it right, people won't have to think about whether it was AI that made this happen or more traditional software."

His test is whether Apple built "something that they really love," he told WIRED.
